summary: Calix filed an 8-K reporting that its Board increased the existing stock repurchase authorization by an additional $100 million, bringing total authorization to $525 million. The remaining authorization as of March 28, 2026, was $63.4 million. Repurchases may be made via open market or private transactions at the company's discretion, with no obligation to acquire a specific amount. The program can be suspended anytime. Watch for actual buyback execution pace relative to disclosed availability; no advisor mentioned.
